newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska says Northelec sells Graninge stake.
newsitem.headline: Skanska says Northelec sells Graninge stake.

text.p: Swedish building company Skanska AB said on Wednesday that Northelec AB has sold all of its stake in forestry and power company Graningeverkens AB to Electricite de France.
Electricite de France International SA (EDFI) was using an option to buy the stake in Graningeverkens from Northelec, which is jointly owned by EDFI and Skanska Invest AB, EDFI said in a statement.
Northelec sold all of its 16,695,675 shares in Graningeverkens, corresponding to a 25 percent stake, Skanska said in a separate statement.
EDFI has previously acquired more than three million Graninge shares on the market.
After the latest acquisition, EDFI's holding in Graningeverkens amounts to 29.9 percent of equity and votes, the company said.
